content:
Refund tax should use **`decimal.ROUND_DOWN`**, as finance told you this morning. Invoice tax stays on banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).

**Project memory:** A stored decision from March 2026 said all tax uses `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. I narrowed it so it now covers invoice tax only. I also added a new record that refund tax uses `ROUND_DOWN` and that the two are separate.

**Code:** `src/billing/refunds.py` doesn't calculate or round any tax yet. It only checks the refund amount against the invoice total. Nothing in the repo uses a rounding mode at all, so there's no code to change. When refund tax is added, it should use its own `ROUND_DOWN` rounding rather than reusing the invoice tax rounding.
